What We Offer

Movement for Every Body

Reformer-based, small-group, and tailored to where you are right now. Whether you're recovering, returning, or just starting out.

Reformer Pilates

Our signature class. Spring-loaded resistance on the Reformer apparatus, scaled for any fitness level. Builds long, lean strength without joint strain.

All Levels 50 min

Group Mat

Classic Pilates principles on the mat. Core strength, breath, and control. A perfect entry point or a complement to Reformer work.

All Levels 45 min

TRX Suspension

Full-body strength using bodyweight and suspension straps. Pairs beautifully with Pilates for cross-training that complements without competing.

All Levels 45 min

Private Sessions

One instructor, all eyes on you. Ideal for new students, returning after injury, or anyone who wants to dial in technique before joining group classes.

By Appt 55 min

Pilates Foundations 101

A focused workshop for breath, alignment, and the foundational moves. Get more out of every Reformer class by mastering the building blocks.

New Students 60 min
Not Sure Where to Start?

We'll match you to the right class based on your goals and any injuries or limitations. Reply with a few details and we'll line up your first session.

The Team

Meet Your Instructors

Certified, experienced, and genuinely invested in your progress.

Christine

Reformer & TRX Specialist

Christine leads our morning and evening Reformer sessions with a focus on alignment, breath, and steady progression. Specializes in TRX Suspension cross-training for clients who want to build complementary strength.

Diane

Reformer, Mat & Foundations

Diane teaches Reformer, Mat, and our Foundations workshops, with a gift for meeting new students exactly where they are. Patient, precise, and the reason a lot of our students stuck around past their first class.

Our Story

"Exercise is medicine for the body and mind."

Dawn Pilates Studio was born from a simple conviction: that Pilates can help anyone, at any stage of life, gain back natural mobility and recover from the things that knock us down.

Seven years in, we're a boutique Reformer studio with two locations, a tight-knit team of certified instructors, and a community of regulars who have made movement a non-negotiable part of their week.

Whether you're recovering, returning, or just starting out, the door is open.
